correctness.rationale: Every nonpolar orbit has exactly m points. For k<2m each fixed subset has at most one such orbit and a unique polar part, producing four explicitly parameterized sphere sheets and no additional intersections by compact/Hausdorff quotient reasoning. The incidence graph has circle rank zero, one or two at exactly the enumerated thresholds; each sheet adds an independent two-sphere. This is an integral homotopy proof; exact cellular ranks in 117 finite cases corroborate rather than prove it.
